Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, history log and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Cross-retainer market workbench: reprice every listing to the live market lowest -N gil, bulk-list inventory with stack splitting. Fork additions: fixes for the duplicate-listing queue crash and stale-snapshot row mismatch, price guards (per-item floor, max drop %, outlier skip), a persistent price-history.csv, a one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle while at the summoning bell.
Changelog: 0.3.2.0 — Per-item price change lines in chat after each cycle; Low stock tab with alerts, market price suggestion (lowest -undercut, Use / Check) , one-click Restock (prefers the retainer that already sells the item), and List & price when nothing is listed (game price window, rest follows). 0.3.1.0 — Auto-advance retainer Talk dialogues, Full cycle (I set prices) button, scrollable plan lists, your price / market lowest beside floors, bait-listing notices, configurable chat channel (default Retainer Sale). 0.3.0.0 — Listing lifecycle and competitor tracking, AutoRetainer coordination, materia name fix, editable interval.
